links.outcome: LLM agent task success on clean versus noisy EHR queries
links.effect: Average task success across proprietary and large-scale open-weight models drops from 62.2% on Clean questions to 37.9% on Noise questions; pass^k consistency at k=4 below 50% for most models.
links.quote: Evaluating multiple LLMs reveals substantial robustness gaps: average task success across proprietary and large-scale open-weight models drops from 62.2% on Clean questions to 37.9% on Noise questions.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning and reinforcement learning of clinical agents in a noisy-EHR environment to improve robustness and generalization to external EHR benchmarks

screen.reason: The study develops a benchmark environment (EHR-RobustGym) to assess the robustness of clinical LLM agents against EHR noise and tests training/fine-tuning methods; it evaluates model robustness and development techniques rather than specific deployment practices or organizational safeguards.
